i.norm: Builds a {@link SparseBloomFilter} of the given shape populated by merging the supplied hasher into it. @param shape the shape of the filter. @param hasher the hasher used to populate the filter. @return the populated filter.
Verifies that {@code asBitMapArray} spans multiple long values when the filter's shape requires more than 64 bits, and that the enabled bits land in the expected words.

A shape of 72 bits needs two longs (words) in the bit map array. The hasher enables bits 63 and 64 (start at 63, increment by 1, k = 2): - bit 63 -> highest bit of word 0 -> 0x8000000000000000 - bit 64 -> lowest bit of word 1 -> 0x1
